name: artifact-sftp
description: Publish, locally read, and safely set up self-contained HTML artifacts on your SFTP web host, including a local stdio MCP adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Publish and read HTML artifacts on your SFTP host
interface.longDescription: Uploads one self-contained HTML file per artifact to an SFTP web host, returns a stable private-by-default URL, provides a local archive that agents can read back without fetching a Cloudflare Access-protected viewer link, and includes a local stdio MCP adapter for setup status, publishing, and read-back.
defaultPrompt: Publish this report as an artifact
Update my published artifact in place
Read the artifact I just published
Set up artifact-sftp on this machine
